project.name: Avalon Creatives Group identity and Open Graph
project.objective: A recognizable logo and legible social-sharing preview for the live Avalon website
project.audience: Prospective clients viewing the website and shared links
project.governing_idea: A connected AV monogram joins strategic direction and creative delivery.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Architectural AV geometry, outlined typography, coral against ivory and charcoal; a sculptural photographic expression for social sharing.

palette.contrast: Ivory type on charcoal; coral symbol

creative_system.typography: Existing custom Avalon outlines plus outlined DejaVu Sans descriptor
invariants: Ideas with vision. Work with impact.

assets.description: Original AV monogram, existing Avalon custom letter outlines, DejaVu Sans descriptor with license in FONT-LICENSE.txt
Built-in imagegen using ast-logo as the identity reference; rendered 2026-10-22; generation exec-ee9f88f5-32e4-4365-8f16-5135053d431a

rights_and_claims.description: User requested a new identity for their connected Avalon site. Existing wordmark geometry comes from that repository. New monogram is original; OG artwork is generated.

review_notes: Reviewed logo presentation on light and dark backgrounds. Corrected descriptor clearance before generation.
Inspected generated OG image for spelling, emblem continuity and readability.
Verified technical export dimensions and optimized 111772-byte JPEG.

assumptions: Use the current site name Avalon Creatives Group, including plural Creatives.
Update live header, mobile menu, footer lockup, root sharing metadata, favicon and bookmark icon.
